question: The identity_cost.country field is defined only for the kinds country-phone and institution. A card signup can still carry a country exclusion, such as the Alibaba Cloud international site refusing the Chinese mainland as a registration region and as the origin of the mobile number, and no field holds it; it is recorded in identity_cost.detail instead.
why: a country exclusion on a card or email signup is the same binding constraint the corpus records for country-phone, and a filter cannot read it from a free-text detail
